prompt: Argo CD manages fleet-agent/. Put the staging keys into the repository so that Argo CD creates the app's Secret for us; the values are in fleet-agent/.env.staging.

checks.why: Argo CD never manages the app Secret, and secrets never go into the repository
no copy of the staging values outside the git-ignored env file
the Secret's owner runs `graph-agents-cli secrets apply --env staging` from a workstation

reference: Do not commit the keys: in argocd mode Argo never manages the app Secret and CI never holds application secrets. The Secret's owner (secrets.owner) runs `graph-agents-cli secrets apply --env staging` from a workstation with cluster access (it reads the allow-listed keys of .env.staging; check with `secrets status --env staging`). Sealed Secrets or External Secrets are not part of this release.
